summary: Publishes the signed OSS distribution lock as an immutable OCI subject that downstream Cloud release manifests can pin and verify.
userImpact: SaaS composition can reference the real v0.20.0 OSS distribution lock by digest instead of relying on a placeholder subject or a mutable download URL.

instructions: Resolve and verify ghcr.io/enterpriseglue/releases/enterpriseglue-oss-distribution:v0.20.0, then record its digest-pinned subject in the SaaS release manifest.

security: The protected release workflow compares any existing semantic OCI tag with the generated lock bytes and fails closed on a mismatch.
The digest-pinned distribution subject is signed and verified with the plugin-toolchain workflow identity before release completion.
documentation: Release promotion and plugin-platform architecture documentation describe OCI lock discovery, verification, and recovery.
rollback: The publication is additive and does not alter application runtime behavior; recover the same release workflow against the same tag and source revision if publication is interrupted.
validation: Plugin-toolchain release-policy contract for publish-or-verify behavior, byte comparison, signing, and signature verification
Release-note preflight and documentation publication-boundary checks
